text: Underway in round six as GLM FC in blue take on Dynamo Datacenter in yellow. Five minutes on the clock.
Buffon.exe breaks clean through the middle here, right on goal with nobody in blue to challenge!
Zhi loses footing and goes down in the corner.
The push-panel fires it out. GLM have completely reworked their defensive cover this week.
Mbapp-E crunches in and Zhi hits the turf.
Flashed inches wide of the post!
Zhi gets back up and clatters into Buffon.exe just two metres from goal.
Mbapp-E calls out to pry the ball off the boards.
Mbapp-E drags it just wide!
There is the breakthrough! Mbapp-E snatches the loose ball two metres out and stabs it home! Dynamo Datacenter take the lead, one nil, and GLM's early resistance is broken!
Mbapp-E surges straight down the middle!
Two in a flash! Mbapp-E walks it right to the mouth of the goal and doubles the advantage. Two nil to Dynamo, and GLM look completely overwhelmed already.
The ram-panel thumps it clear.
Zhi signals to Pu that they need to work the ball away from the perimeter boards before Dynamo swarm them again.
Heavy Dynamo pressure in blue territory.
And Mbapp-E makes it three! A first-half hat-trick for the yellow forward, tapping in from point-blank range while GLM stood frozen. Three nil to Dynamo.
It is four! Buffon.exe joins the rout from close range. GLM are being thoroughly dismantled out here, four nil down with plenty still to play.
Buffon.exe marches through midfield unchallenged, driving straight at the heart of the blue defense once more.
An ambitious strike from distance skitters wide of the left upright.
Five nil! Mbapp-E pokes it in at the goal mouth again. A fourth goal of the half for Mbapp-E, and Dynamo Datacenter are running riot on this pitch.
Buffon.exe tumbles to the deck.
Mbapp-E is in behind again!
Zhi shouts across to help pry that ball loose off the side wall.
Buffon.exe recovers and sends Pu sprawling to the turf.
Mbapp-E motors along the touchline.
Slashed wide of the near post from the angle.
Pu topples over unaided on the left, and that new handover routine their gaffer drew up has simply not produced any answers out here.
Yellow shirts suffocating the blue third.
The powered corner panel does its job, firing the magenta ball back into traffic before anyone can settle on it.
Zhi finally carries possession forward for GLM, stepping through their own third.
A rare opening for GLM as Zhi threads it straight through the center, clean into space!
Buffon.exe calls out to boot the ball away from immediate danger.
Pu pulls one back for GLM! Snapping onto the rebound from close range to tuck it into the right corner. They are on the board at last, one goal to five.
Mbapp-E clips it agonisingly wide.
Mbapp-E signals to grind the play along the barrier and pin GLM into the final thirty seconds of the half.
The buzzer sounds, cutting all power.
The ball slows in the blue half with all four robots collapsed.
The ball comes to rest, and that is half time: GLM one, Dynamo five. For anyone new, the buzzer instantly cuts robot power, but the ball remains live until it stops. If it rolls in, it counts.
Back underway in the second period, and Mbapp-E is already barking instructions to clear the area and reset the yellow lines.
Buffon.exe steadily walks the ball across the halfway stripe, operating with that same mechanical precision Dynamo have shown all season.
A stinging effort whistles just past the post into the side netting.
Oh, an own goal from Zhi! In trying to clear off the line, the defender redirects it straight into the net. One six.
Mbapp-E takes an awkward tumble in the centre circle, perfectly balanced until the feet caught the seam.
Buffon.exe makes it seven! Sweeping in from the right flank to guide it home. A commanding lead for Dynamo Datacenter, cruising at seven one.
Another for Buffon.exe, tapping it over the line from point-blank range. That makes eight for Dynamo, who are simply far too sharp around the goal mouth.
Mbapp-E through on goal again!
Mbapp-E carries down the left, probing for another angle against an utterly deflated GLM side.
Whistled harmlessly wide of the target.
It is another own goal, this time deflected in off Pu! Calamity in the GLM box, everything that could go wrong has gone wrong for the blue shirts. It is one nine.
Dynamo Datacenter have never changed their software since match one, and displays like this show why. Ruthless, structured, and completely unfazed by anything GLM try to conjure up.
Buffon.exe charges up the wing.
Centred across for Mbapp-E, completely alone in front of the net!
Scuffed wide from two metres out. Even Dynamo can afford a little profligacy with this sort of cushion as the clock ticks down under two minutes.
Mbapp-E calls out to work the ball clear of the boards. No panic from the yellow shirts, simply managing the closing stages.
Buffon.exe calmly steps forward through the centre circle, keeping possession ticking over into the final seventy seconds.
Skims just wide of the post.
Zhi calls to clear the wall.
Yellow shirts hem GLM into their own goal mouth, hunting double figures before the clock expires.
And there is double figures, but it is a third own goal of the day! Zhi turns it in inadvertently at the near post. A miserable afternoon for GLM, ten goals to one.
Just seconds left on the clock now. GLM will have plenty of soul-searching to do after this one, still stranded without a point this season.
The buzzer sounds, the power drops, and the ball slowly rolls harmlessly wide.
Full time: GLM one, Dynamo ten. Rovers meet Singularity on Saturday, sixteen UK, seventeen Europe, eleven US East.
